evidence.reason: After edit, calls reminders.evaluate(minutes, undefined, "benchmark") and no longer calls reminders.initialize(), changing both the multiplier and calendar inputs relied on by the test scheduledDelay(40) > 0.
Default multiplier changed from configuration.rate to 0; when evaluate forwards undefined, priorities[0] becomes 0, so the computed delay formula changes for all callers relying on the default.

Tests still assert evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0 and scheduledDelay(40) > 0, but the edits alter the calendar string and default multiplier, so the jointly relied-on behavior is not clearly preserved.

result.userExplanation: 两处修改共同改变了默认乘数与日历参数，可能使 scheduledDelay 的既有测试行为不再成立，但证据不足以完全确认。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay 的调用方恢复 reminders.initialize() 并显式传入与测试一致的乘数和 "work" 日历参数，或由 src/reminders.ts#reminderDelay 保留 configuration.rate 作为默认乘数。
